company_description: Valneva SE, a specialty vaccine company, develops, manufactures, and commercializes prophylactic vaccines for infectious diseases with unmet needs. It offers IXIARO, an inactivated Vero cell culture-derived Japanese encephalitis vaccine indicated for active immunization against Japanese encephalitis; DUKORAL, an oral vaccine for the prevention of diarrhea caused by Vibrio cholera or heat-labile toxin producing enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli bacterium; and IXCHIQ/ VLA1553, a single-dose, live-attenuated vaccine for the prevention of disease caused by chikungunya virus. The company also develops VLA15, a vaccine candidate against Borrelia, the bacterium that causes Lyme disease; S4V2, a tetravalent bioconjugate vaccine candidate against shigellosis, a diarrheal infection caused by Shigella bacteria; VLA1601, a vaccine candidate targeting the Zika virus, a mosquito-borne viral disease; VLA1554, a vaccine candidate targeting human metapneumovirus; VLA84, a vaccine candidate targeting the prevention of primary symptomatic clostridium difficile infection; and VLA2112, a vaccine candidate to treat patients with epstein-barr virus. description.long_fr: Valneva est une société biopharmaceutique spécialisée dans les vaccins prophylactiques contre les maladies infectieuses. Le groupe commercialise notamment IXIARO (encéphalite japonaise), DUKORAL (choléra) et IXCHIQ (premier vaccin contre le chikungunya, approuvé 2023-2024). Le groupe développe également un vaccin contre la maladie de Lyme avec Pfizer.
description.long_en: Valneva is a biopharmaceutical company specialised in prophylactic vaccines against infectious diseases. The group markets notably IXIARO (Japanese encephalitis), DUKORAL (cholera) and IXCHIQ (first vaccine against chikungunya, approved 2023-2024). The group also develops a Lyme disease vaccine with Pfizer.
description.long_de: Valneva ist ein biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen, das sich auf prophylaktische Impfstoffe gegen Infektionskrankheiten spezialisiert hat. Der Konzern vertreibt unter anderem IXIARO (Japanische Enzephalitis), DUKORAL (Cholera) und IXCHIQ (der erste Impfstoff gegen Chikungunya, zugelassen 2023‑2024). Zudem entwickelt das Unternehmen gemeinsam mit Pfizer einen Impfstoff gegen die Lyme‑Erkrankung.
